protocol.baseline_podium: 0.65 for race-baseline top three; 1.05/(field_size-3) otherwise, fixed before evaluation
protocol.baseline_qualifying: last-three-event driver qualifying form, then team form, then neutral; deterministic driver-id tie break
protocol.baseline_race: published target qualifying rank, then prior driver race form, then team form, then neutral
protocol.calibration: last two earlier events reserved for out-of-fold sigmoid calibration and threshold when at least eight earlier events; otherwise identity and 0.5
protocol.eligibility: independent cutoff-valid entry lists and reviewed final labels; unknown labels masked
protocol.evaluation: rank metrics use only explicitly numbered targets; all field drivers predicted; unknown podium labels masked; metrics macro-average events
protocol.exposure: Historical outcomes have been consulted; no untouched holdout claim
protocol.history: strict earlier available calendar-event windows, not last driver appearances
protocol.prediction_seal: config and forecast hashes frozen before target labels are joined or scored
protocol.preprocessing: observed/nonconstant feature selection, median imputation, scale, one-hot fitted on training only
protocol.selection: at most last three pre-calibration development events, expanding chronological training; minimum three earlier training events
protocol.selection_metric: event-mean rank MAE for ranks; event-mean Brier for podium
protocol.target: explicit official numeric rank normalized by independent field size; unknown/NC/DSQ ranks excluded
protocol.threshold: calibration-OOF F1 on 0.10..0.90 by 0.05; ties nearest 0.5
protocol.training_scope: 2026-only, earlier FIA evidence available before target weekend
protocol.training_weight: each event has equal total sample weight within each task
